components.name: Plaque Button
components.description: Default action plaque; inverts to ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #1f1c19); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--plaster, #f1efe6); color: var(--ink, #1f1c19); font: 700 1rem var(--sans, 'Zen Kaku Gothic New', sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--ink, #1f1c19); color: var(--plaster, #f1efe6); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #9a321e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one vermilion action per group (Email).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #1f1c19); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--shu, #c2462c); color: #fbf7ef; font: 700 1rem var(--sans, 'Zen Kaku Gothic New', sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: background .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--shu-deep, #9c3420); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #9a321e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Filter and term-tab plaque; selected is vermilion.
components.css: .ds-chip { font: 700 .92rem var(--sans, 'Zen Kaku Gothic New', sans-serif); min-height: 40px; padding: 6px 14px; border: 2px solid var(--rule, #1f1c19); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--panel, #f1f3ec); color: var(--text, #1f1c19); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #9a321e); color: var(--accent, #9a321e); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--shu, #c2462c); border-color: var(--ink, #1f1c19); color: #fbf7ef; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #9a321e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 10px 24px; background: var(--ground, #e6ebe3); color: var(--text, #1f1c19); border-bottom: 3px double var(--rule, #1f1c19); } .ds-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-right: auto; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand svg { color: var(--shu, #c2462c); } .ds-brand span { font: 400 1.05rem/1.1 var(--display, 'Dela Gothic One', sans-serif); } .ds-brand small { display: block; font: 400 .78rem var(--sans, sans-serif); color: var(--muted, #4b5249); letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-links { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-links a { font: 700 .95rem var(--sans, sans-serif); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 3px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-links a:hover { color: var(--accent, #9a321e); } .ds-links a[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--ink, #1f1c19); color: var(--ground, #e6ebe3); } .ds-tool { font: 700 .85rem/1 var(--sans, sans-serif); min-width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 0 10px; border: 2px solid var(--rule, #1f1c19); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--panel, #f1f3ec); color: var(--text, #1f1c19); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tool:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #9a321e); color: var(--accent, #9a321e); } .ds-links a:focus-visible, .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #9a321e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Section Seal Heading
components.description: Rotated vermilion kanji stamp beside a display h2.
components.css: .ds-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; color: var(--text, #1f1c19); } .ds-seal { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 52px; height: 52px; border: 3px solid var(--shu, #c2462c); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--shu, #c2462c); font: 400 1.7rem/1 var(--kanji, 'Dela CJK', 'Dela Gothic One', sans-serif); transform: rotate(-4deg); } .ds-head h2 { margin: 0; font: 400 clamp(1.8rem, 3.4vw, 2.6rem)/1.1 var(--display, 'Dela Gothic One', sans-serif); }

components.css: .ds-log { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; position: relative; font-family: var(--sans, sans-serif); color: var(--text, #1f1c19); } .ds-log::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 27px; top: 30px; bottom: 30px; border-left: 4px dotted color-mix(in srgb, var(--rule, #1f1c19) 45%, transparent); } .ds-log li { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 58px 1fr; gap: 22px; align-items: center; padding-bottom: 24px; } .ds-ls { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 58px; height: 58px; border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid var(--ink, #1f1c19); font: 400 1.6rem var(--kanji, 'Dela CJK', sans-serif); } .ds-won { background: var(--shu, #c2462c); color: #fbf7ef; } .ds-on { background: var(--gold, #c99b3f); color: var(--ink, #1f1c19); } .ds-plan { background: var(--ground, #e6ebe3); color: var(--muted, #4b5249); border-color: var(--rule, #1f1c19); border-style: dashed; } .ds-log b { color: var(--muted, #4b5249); margin-right: 8px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Commander's Ezu"**

The site is a campaign map. A real coastline (Te Atatū Peninsula, Auckland) is redrawn as an Edo-period 絵図 crossed with a cartoony RPG world map: matte aizome sea with seigaiha waves, moss-and-ochre land, a castle keep, gold kasumi cloud bands, pines, ships, a torii, and six named banners that mark the campaigns. Everything is outlined in warm sumi ink and laid on a cool celadon washi ground with a fixed paper-grain overlay. Nothing is glossy; there are no gradients on chrome and only one shadow in the whole system.

Content pages read as the map's margins. Sections are framed by double-rule borders (枠), each headed by a rotated vermilion seal carrying one kanji. The research record is a march route of round status seals (勝 won, 進 ongoing, 和 stalemate, 備 planned) joined by a dotted line. Controls are small wooden plaques: square-ish 3px corners, 2px ink borders, bold sans labels. The density is calm and editorial; the world frames the reading and never replaces it.

On capable desktops (min-width 761px, fine pointer, 4+ cores, no reduced motion) the hero upgrades to a three.js low-poly village diorama with the same pigments in fully matte, flat-shaded materials (roughness 1, metalness 0), fog `#d6e4e6`, a hemisphere light and one warm sun. The SVG map is always the fallback and the no-JS state.
keyCharacteristics: Map pigments are fixed in both themes: the map is an object, not chrome.
Sumi-ink outlines (2-3px, round joins) on every drawn map element.
Double-rule (3px double) borders as the structural frame line.
Kanji seals as section markers and status markers.
Matte everywhere: washi grain overlay at 16% multiply, no gloss, one shadow.
Bilingual EN / 中文 via a toggle; English is the no-JS default.

rules.name: The Fixed Pigment Rule
rules.body: Map pigments (sea through wood) never change with theme. Only page roles (ground, panel, text, muted, rule, accent, focus) are themed.

rules.name: The One Vermilion Rule
rules.body: Shu is the only saturated hue on a screen. Use it for markers, seals, the primary action and state; body text links use the accent role, not raw shu.

rules.name: The Subset Rule
rules.body: "Dela CJK" carries only the glyphs it was cut for. Never set running Chinese text in it; Chinese body copy uses the body stack.

rules.name: The Display-Is-400 Rule
rules.body: Dela Gothic One is only ever weight 400. Never fake-bold it.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only the cartouche casts a shadow. Panels, cards and buttons stay flat and are separated by rules.

dos: Do outline every drawn map element in ink (2-3px, round line joins).
Do frame sections and panels with the 3px double rule and head each campaign with a rotated kanji seal.
Do keep map pigments identical in light and dark themes; theme only the page roles.
Do use the four honest status seals (勝 進 和 備) for any record of outcomes, and never mark planned work as won.
Do keep reading text in Zen Kaku Gothic New at 1.0625rem/1.7 within 68ch.
Do keep the SVG map as the no-JS and reduced-capability hero; the 3D scene is an upgrade only.
Do keep all motion skippable and off under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add shadows, gloss, specular highlights or gradients to chrome; the one shadow belongs to the cartouche and 3D materials stay roughness 1, metalness 0.
Don't introduce a second saturated hue alongside shu.
Don't set running Chinese text in Dela CJK or bold Dela Gothic One.
Don't round controls beyond 3px or use pill buttons.
